basis.provenanceNote: NC-WE-06 (art. 9.20) is sub-class-scoped to detailhandel; the over-broad area exclusion was re-adjudicated (WN-03). This variant makes that strict reading an explicit, visible policy choice.

scenarios.name: Bedrijventerrein designation expanded by a 500 m band

basis.rationale: The designation envelope is a programming area; a 500 m band is not cited anywhere — this hypothetical measures what it would add.
basis.provenanceNote: NOT legally grounded: the designation (NC-WE-03, art. 9.16) is cited, the 500 m band is the scenario's own parameter.

notes: Phase A deterministic sweep (docs/GENAI_SEAMS.md): no LLM at runtime; scenario specs are schema-validated contracts authored by deterministic-scenario-author#poc-v0.
Deltas are measured against the unmutated control re-executed over the baseline run's cached layers (same tunings), not against summary numbers.
Marker semantics (attention/conditional/compensation) never alter the opportunity zone; set_semantics mutations make that policy choice explicit and visible in the delta.
